fields: [pic=2]So how’s your stay been so far?
[pic=3]Lots of folks seem to enjoy being busy, but personally, I like the slower pace of things…
[pic=1]Oh gosh, maybe I’m just getting old!
[pic=2]Aaand here we are! Please remain seated while we begin our descent!
[pic=2]Bahaw! I hear you’ve been running some errands!
[pic=4]The folks are keeping you busy, eh?
[pic=6]Don’t worry, that means they like ya!
[pic=7]Though… We might be coming up on some turbulence…
[pic=1]Look’s like we’re here though, prepare to descend!
[pic=4]This is your fourth trip with me. How do you like flying?

It’s actually incredible!
The sights are magnificent.
[pic=4]Right? It’s crazy to think! There’s SO MUCH space up here!
[pic=3]It’s a shame only us flyin’ folk can appreciate it.
[pic=2]I’m so glad I can share it with you critters!
[pic=2]Oh! Here we are! Prepare for landing!

Still pretty scary…
And your jokes don’t help!
[pic=1]Baww! Hah! That’s tough love for ya, Rascal!
[pic=3]Y’know, most of us birds learn how to fly by FALLING. A LOT!
[pic=4]Gotta rip off that bandaid, y’know? Only then will you see that things aren’t so scary!
[pic=6]Besides, the jokes are a complementary service! Those aren’t goin’ anywhere, bahaw!
[pic=2]Y’know, I’ve been seeing you a lot today…
[pic=4]Normally I don’t see the same critter more than twice a day…
[pic=1]Not that I mind of course! I’ll ferry your cute rump all day long!
[pic=6]Oh gosh, don’t tell my boss I’m flirting with you! Bahaw!
[pic=6]Right? I hear the flight attendant isn’t half bad lookin’ either!
[pic=3]Must be nice, I keep gettin’ stuck with these lazy free loaders!
[pic=6]Y’all got legs, don’tcha? Bahaw just messin’, dear!
[pic=2]All this glowing glyph business has been super exciting!
[pic=4]Good things actually! I think they’re becoming more curious about it.
[pic=3]I feel like things are just beginning!
[pic=2]Have you ever been up this high?
[pic=1]Don’t you worry dear, I’ve never dropped a critter before.
[pic=3]Poor old Fred, he was a good bun…
[pic=1]BAHAWHAW Just kidding! You’ll be fine dear!
[pic=2]Oh and look! Here is your stop!
[pic=1]I’ll take it you’re trembling from excitement then!
[pic=1]Most critters nearly piss themselves from fear their first time!
[pic=3]Oh uh, don’t worry, I thoroughly wash after those incidents.
[pic=2]I’ve been doing these flights long before you were born.

During flights. Penny will talk to you about random various things. I’ll include a list of stuff she’ll go through, but this first one will be scripted. After a certain amount of flights you can unlock her scene. Also maybe you need to be in like, act 3 or something.
